<h1 id="从开始配置漏洞环境到漏洞复现流程">从开始配置漏洞环境到漏洞复现流程</h1>
<p>今天举的例子是https://github.com/FeMiner/wms/issues#7</p>
<h2 id="一环境搭建">一、环境搭建</h2>
<h3 id="1安装docker">1.安装docker</h3>
<pre><code>curl -fsSL https://get.docker.com | bash
sudo systemctl start docker
</code></pre>
<p>或者直接去官网下载所需版本</p>
<p><a href="https://www.docker.com/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://www.docker.com/</a><br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3267338/202604/3267338-20260412222714752-1381832709.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h3 id="2配置php56环境">2.配置php5.6环境</h3>
<p>进入到项目文件夹后在项目外层新建 <code>Dockerfile</code>文件，不需要加后缀</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3267338/202604/3267338-20260412222733720-1768372252.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<pre><code>FROM php:5.6-apache

RUN a2enmod rewrite \
    &amp;&amp; docker-php-ext-install mysql mysqli

WORKDIR /var/www/html
</code></pre>
<p>把以上信息添加进去意思是：</p>
<p>以 <code>php:5.6-apache</code> 这个现成基础镜像为底座</p>
<p>在里面再装这个老项目需要的 PHP 扩展</p>
<p>把默认工作目录放到网站目录</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3267338/202604/3267338-20260412222812964-871677549.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>然后再新建 <code>docker-compose.yml</code>，建在同一层目录下</p>
<p>因为当 <code>build: .</code> 时，Compose 会把<strong>当前目录</strong>当作 build context，并在这个目录根部找 <code>Dockerfile</code>；<code>docker compose up --build</code> 会先构建再启动服务</p>
<p><code>web</code>：跑 PHP 网站</p>
<p><code>db</code>：跑 MySQL 数据库</p>
<pre><code>services:
  web:
    build: .
    container_name: wms_web
    ports:
      - "8081:80"
    volumes:
      - ./src:/var/www/html
    depends_on:
      db:
        condition: service_healthy

  db:
    image: mysql:5.7
    container_name: wms_db
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: hust
      MYSQL_DATABASE: db_wms
    ports:
      - "3306:3306"
    command: --default-authentication-plugin=mysql_native_password
    volumes:
      - dbdata:/var/lib/mysql
      - ./src/system/uploads/db_wms.sql:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/01-db_wms.sql:ro
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "mysqladmin ping -h localhost -phust --silent"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 20

volumes:
  dbdata:
</code></pre>
<p>可以先单独拉两个镜像</p>
<pre><code>docker pull php:5.6-apache
docker pull mysql:5.7
</code></pre>
<p>我在复现这个漏洞的时候把wms-master/src/conn/conn.php中的文件中的把 <code>localhost</code> 改成 <code>db</code>，单纯为了方便我的数据库连结</p>
<p>然后重启服务</p>
<p>docker compose down -v<br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3267338/202604/3267338-20260412222849661-1435002930.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>docker compose up -d --build<br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3267338/202604/3267338-20260412222946080-41855632.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>查看状态（可以忽略）</p>
<p>docker compose ps</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3267338/202604/3267338-20260412222958298-1893067317.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>在本地打开</p>
<p><a href="http://localhost:8081" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">http://localhost:8081</a></p>
<p>如果不成的话说明Apache没有配成</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3267338/202604/3267338-20260412223030306-210750461.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>phpstudy可以运行php环境代码</p>
<p>一共需要的服务</p>
<p>Apache</p>
<p>PHP 5.6</p>
<p>MySQL 5.7</p>
<h2 id="二漏洞复现">二、漏洞复现</h2>
<h3 id="1打开漏洞文件的位置打开editinoutphp进行代码审计">1.打开漏洞文件的位置，打开editinout.php进行代码审计</h3>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3267338/202604/3267338-20260412223049244-1492472515.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>发现直接拼接的$_get['id']的sql语句</p>
<p>确定注入点</p>
<h3 id="2进入到漏洞出现的本地网址">2.进入到漏洞出现的本地网址</h3>
<p><a href="http://localhost:8081/vms/basic/editinout.php" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">http://localhost:8081/vms/basic/editinout.php</a></p>
<p><strong>判断注入点：</strong></p>
<pre><code>http://localhost:8081/vms/basic/editinout.php?id=1
</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3267338/202604/3267338-20260412223108398-1196838913.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>发现并无报错，漏洞成立</p>
<p>直接上sqlmap扫描</p>
<pre><code>sqlmap -u "http://localhost:8081/vms/basic/editinout.php?id=1" --batch
</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3267338/202604/3267338-20260412223124504-276908790.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>得到数据库，成功复现</p>
